suitPayment: Domestic custom garment orders require a 70% advance before production and the remaining 30% before release or delivery. For custom tailoring, the balance is due when tailoring is complete and before final cleaning and delivery. Full payment is required before garment release. Standalone alterations, cleaning, mobile assistance and VIP requests use the payment arrangement stated in the accepted quotation; do not assume the suit schedule applies to every service.
standalonePayment: Payment requirements for standalone alterations, cleaning, mobile and VIP services are agreed in the quotation before work starts. Full payment is required before release. A payment screenshot does not establish received funds.
balance: With a 70% advance, the balance is 30%. Your actual balance is the agreed total less payments already received.
contents: The documented men’s two-piece suit contains a jacket and trousers; a three-piece adds a waistcoat. Women’s two- and three-piece business or ceremony styles are confirmed in the quotation. Men’s tuxedos have separate packages; ordinary suit accessories and women’s tuxedos must not be assumed.
package: The documented standard Kigali custom-suit package includes initial standard cleaning, protective packaging and initial Kigali delivery. Included services are not charged twice.
extras: Extra fabric, decorations, embroidery, attachments and special requirements need a quotation and confirmation before payment.
higherCollections: Approved ordinary-suit and men’s tuxedo starting prices appear in the Fabric Guide. Fabric labels do not prove composition or stock; exact design, suitability and final quotation require confirmation.
delivery: Initial Kigali delivery is included in the documented standard custom-suit package. Additional or outside-Kigali delivery requires an agreed quotation where applicable. Confirm address, time and required payment before dispatch. No shipping price or delivery deadline is assumed. Eligible Kigali alterations and garment-care orders have a 10,000 RWF total collection-and-return charge for the round trip. The same order combining alterations and cleaning is not charged twice. Customer drop-off, professional visits, included initial Kigali custom-suit delivery and international shipping are different arrangements. Location eligibility and any separate arrangement are confirmed in the quotation; no nationwide delivery price is implied.
timing: Standard Custom Tailoring & Suits takes 1–3 weeks. Express takes 2–3 days, subject to feasibility and capacity confirmation. Measurements, fabric/material availability, fittings and operational requirements may affect completion. Your actual completion date is agreed before order acceptance; a requested deadline is not automatically accepted.
alterationTiming: Standard Clothing Alterations & Repairs takes 12–15 working hours; Express takes 2–12 working hours, subject to inspection, feasibility and capacity. Working hours are not consecutive clock hours or calendar days. The actual completion date is confirmed before acceptance.
careTiming: Standard Garment Care & Cleaning takes approximately 3 days. Express garment care takes 2–12 hours, subject to confirmation, garment assessment and available capacity. No stain-removal or fabric-outcome guarantee is given. The actual completion date is agreed before acceptance.
